notablePrerequisites: At least 6 other cards in hand or graveyard.
description:
Cast Lotus Petal, triggering Kykar and making a spirit.
Crack Lotus and Spirit for {1}{R}.
Use that and the extra open {1} to cast Wheel of Fortune, triggering Kykar and making a spirit.
Discard your hand, and draw 7.
Cast Lotus petal with escape, creating another spirit.Sacrificeboth spirits and crack Lotus Petal with escape to cast Wheel of Fortune with escape.
Both casts make 2 more spirits.
